question: What was our monthly revenue trend over the last 12 months?
sql:
SELECT DATE_TRUNC(DATE(o.created_at), MONTH) AS month,
       ROUND(SUM(oi.sale_price), 2) AS revenue,
       COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) AS orders,
       ROUND(SUM(oi.sale_price)/NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id),0), 2) AS aov
FROM `bigquery-public-data.thelook_ecommerce.orders` o
JOIN `bigquery-public-data.thelook_ecommerce.order_items` oi ON oi.order_id = o.order_id
WHERE o.status NOT IN ('Cancelled','Returned')
  AND o.created_at >= TIMESTAMP_SUB(CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), INTERVAL 365 DAY)
GROUP BY month
ORDER BY month
analyst_report: Report month-over-month AND year-over-year for the same month - retail is seasonal and MoM alone will make November look like a miracle and January like a catastrophe every single year. Flag the current (partial) month explicitly; it is always down and executives always ask about it. Pair revenue with AOV so a revenue dip can be immediately attributed to volume vs basket size.
analyst_method_notes: Truncate on DATE(created_at), not on the raw timestamp.
The most recent month is partial - either exclude it or label it clearly.
Always carry AOV alongside revenue so the reader can decompose a change.
